report.title: Report this message
report.intro: Our team reviews every report. The author of the message does not know who reported it.

reasonHints.illegal: Content that breaks the law: hatred, threats, scams, counterfeiting, invasion of privacy…
reasonHints.harassment: Insults, intimidation or targeting a person.
reasonHints.spam: Advertising, repeated links or messages unrelated to the lounge.
reasonHints.personal_data: Someone’s address, phone, photo or details posted without their consent.
reasonHints.other: Another breach of the terms of use.

report.detailsPlaceholder: What the problem is and, for unlawful content, why you think it breaks the law.
report.privacy: Your report and your name are kept by the team to handle the request and are never shown to the author of the message. Reporting in bad faith may lead to measures.
report.receivedBody: We received your report on {{date}}. Our team is reviewing it and will tell you its decision by e-mail.

errors.category: Choose the category of unlawful content.

errors.failed: The report could not be sent. Try again.
